seo.title: Klaviyo integration | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect Klaviyo to Steps AI so customers from WhatsApp, Instagram and website chats can be part of your Klaviyo email and SMS marketing.

hero.title: Connect your chat conversations to Klaviyo.
hero.body: If your email and SMS marketing runs on Klaviyo, connect it so the customers your agent talks to can be part of your Klaviyo marketing.
hero.reassurance: Connected once. Used in skills and workflows. Your team stays informed.

lines.text: I would like to speak to someone about a bulk order.
Of course. I have let our team know and someone will join this chat shortly.

useCases.title: What you can do with Klaviyo connected.
useCases.intro: Use Klaviyo as a step in your workflows and agent skills.

items.title: Grow your marketing lists
items.body: Customers who share their email in the chat can be added to your Klaviyo marketing.

items.title: Keep chat and email together
items.body: Use what customers ask in the chat alongside the emails and texts you already send from Klaviyo.

items.title: Use it in workflows
items.body: Add Klaviyo as a step in a workflow next to your store and messaging apps.

setup.title: Connect Klaviyo in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect Klaviyo
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose Klaviyo. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds Klaviyo to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Use it in a workflow or skill
items.body: Add a Klaviyo step to a workflow, or use it in a flow skill, and choose what it should do.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: The actions available for Klaviyo depend on your setup. We will show you exactly what it can do in your demo.
Workflows save as drafts until you switch them on.

items.q: Where do I use Klaviyo after connecting it?
items.a: In the workflow builder and in flow skills, where a connected app can be chosen as an action.

items.q: Do I need to write code?
items.a: No. You choose steps from menus. Advanced options such as webhooks are there if your team wants them.

cta.title: See Steps AI work with Klaviyo.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through a real conversation using Klaviyo and your own information.
